name: comp-504
title: Advanced Year Month Picker
description: A compact month calendar whose heading is a button: pressing it swaps the day grid for a scrollable run of years, each opening into a three-across grid of month buttons. Picking a month returns to the days.
use: People jump far back or forward in time and picking a month and year beats paging month by month.
avoid: The jump list only covers 1980 to 2030, so dates outside that span can never be reached.
a11y: Year rows report aria-expanded and days are buttons, but the month heading never says it opens a chooser. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A small bordered black panel shows the month name with a chevron, dim angle arrows, a weekday row and five rows of day numbers. Overlaid, the same panel becomes a stack of year rows, the open year showing twelve rounded month buttons in three columns.
behaves: Pressing the month heading covers the days with the year list and rotates its chevron. Each year row expands or folds; tapping a month closes the list and drops back to that month's days, as November gives way to March in the frames.
customise: The 1980-2030 year span, starting month and caption link are set in the file; month labels and single-date mode come from the shared calendar.
weight: light: One month grid plus a scrollable list of 51 years; no continuous animation.
